name: link-preview

frames.best_why: Fully settled Next.js screenshot card floating above its underlined link.

tagline: Hovering an underlined link floats up a small screenshot of its page.
summary: A word inside body copy opens a rounded card showing a screenshot of the page it points to. The card springs up above the link and drifts sideways as the pointer moves.
appearance: A white rounded card floats above an underlined link, holding a small screenshot of the linked page with a thin light border and soft shadow. It sits over a dark stage with a bold sentence beneath.
behaviour: Hovering a link for a moment pops the preview up from below with a spring, and it slides slightly sideways as the pointer crosses the word. It closes after a short delay when the pointer leaves.
demo_content: Sentence 'Built with Next.js and deployed on Vercel.' with previews of the Next.js and Vercel homepages.
search_phrases: hover link to show website screenshot
see page before clicking a link
link that opens a mini screenshot
use_when: Body copy contains links and a screenshot would help readers decide whether to click.
avoid_when: Live screenshots depend on an external API per URL, and the preview is only wired to hover.
customise: Pass the target url, the visible label as children, and a width and height; use isStatic with your own imageSrc or leave it to the live screenshot service. Styling comes through className.
weight_why: A small hover card with one image and a spring slide.

a11y.note: The preview pops with a spring and no reduced-motion check; both images use generic alt text.

issues: The floating card covers the hint text above the sentence when it opens.
polish_why: Crisp card and smooth spring entrance; the card can overlap nearby copy.
title: Link Preview
